info.title: Workflowy Universal API
info.description: Manage Workflowy nodes, search lists, and organize content

put.description: Marks a Workflowy node as completed.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

id.description: The identifier of the node to complete.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a new node in Workflowy.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

name.description: The text content of the new node.

parentId.description: Node UUID, target key like home or inbox, or None for a top-level node.

note.description: Additional note content for the node.

layoutMode.description: Display mode like bullets, todo, h1, h2, or h3.

position.description: Where to place the node: top or bottom.

itemId.description: The identifier of the newly created node.
